name: KNOREX LTD.
summary: Knorex Ltd. operates as a technology firm specializing in software solutions for digital advertising. The company's primary product, knorex XPO, is an enterprise-grade, self-service cloud platform. It offers a comprehensive suite of applications designed for the management and execution of advertising (AMX). Knorex Ltd. was founded in Singapore on May 9, 2023, where its headquarters are located.
